_about: RATIFIED Company Standard LATE-INTEREST-MSA-001 (AM-166, 2026-10-19). The position is Legal
Constitution §16's Company Position, which is not specific to one paper: "late payments accrue
interest at 2% per month, subject to applicable law". The published TOS states its own 5% per month
(LATE-FEE-TOS-001, owner ruling 2026-10-09: the published website text is authoritative) and is
never measured against this one. It is CONFIGURATION: no locked decision is amended.
A rate stated per ANNUM is a different unit and is not converted (simple against compound interest
is not definitional): it fails closed to a person (UNABLE_TO_EVALUATE) rather than being read as
equal or unequal to 2% per month. A lower or a higher rate is a DEVIATION for a person; no tolerance
band exists. The clause 'subject to applicable law' travels with the position: Indian courts may
reduce a rate they find penal (Contract Act 1872 s.74; Constitution §27 Item 3, Counsel Validation).
description: Late payments accrue interest at the company's standard monthly rate, subject to applicable law.
